Prototype: Modelling New York 2

Andy CASA, UCL East

In a second post on Prototype - a forthcoming game from Radical Entertainment - we feature an interesting insight into their modelling of New York.

The movie below provides various concept drawings and views of the model imported into the game:



Its interesting how well New York has been recreated for the game, although to be honest the last section of the video was slightly cringe worthy on delivering a product.

The game is scheduled for release on PC, PS3 and XBox 360 in 2008 - date yet to be confirmed.

See http://www.prototypegame.org for more screen shots and videos.

Thanks to Ian for posting a comment letting us know of the new video...
